flows.title: Create a dashboard
steps: Navigate to Create > Dashboard. From inside a chart, clicking + Add to and then + Create a new dashboard does the same.
Type the dashboard's name where it reads Untitled Dashboard. Amplitude saves the new, still-empty dashboard.
Click Add Content, select the type of content from the drop-down, then select the items in the panel that opens on the right.
Repeat until the dashboard holds everything it needs.

flows.title: Import a cohort from a file
steps: Navigate to Cohorts & Audiences and click Import from CSV.
Select a CSV or text file of user IDs or Amplitude IDs: one ID per line, no header row, no extra spaces, and under 100MB.
Specify whether the file contains Amplitude IDs, user IDs or groups.

flows.title: Add events to a chart
steps: In the chart's Events module, click Add Event or Metric. Amplitude lists the available events, and a chart can hold up to 10.
Search for the event. If the exact name is unknown, change the operator to *(glob match) and use a wildcard such as *chart*.
To narrow an event, add a Filter by condition on an event or user property. To break the results out by a property, use Group-by instead.
